outer_diameter = 80.0

mount_hole_diameter = 5.0
mount_hole_radius = 30.0

            l3 = Line(l2 @ 1, (shoulder_length, shoulder_diameter / 2))
            l4 = Line(l3 @ 1, (shaft_length, shoulder_diameter / 2))
            l5 = Line(l4 @ 1, (shaft_length, 0))
            l6 = Line(l5 @ 1, (0, 0))
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.X)

solid_body = p.part
solid_body = offset(solid_body, amount=-wall_thickness, openings=[])

top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.X)[-1]
solid_body = chamfer(top_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

bottom_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.X)[0]
solid_body = chamfer(bottom_face.edges(), chamfer_size)

slot_box = Pos(shaft_length / 2, 0, 0) * Box(slot_depth, slot_width, slot_height)
solid_body = solid_body - slot_box

for y in [-mount_hole_spacing / 2, mount_hole_spacing / 2]:
    hole = Pos(shaft_length / 2, y, 0) * Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(mount_hole_dia / 2, shaft_length + 20)
    solid_body = solid_body - hole

part = solid_body
part.name = "shaft_with_slot_and_mount_holes"
export_step(part, "output.step")
